note: Authored situation/context clauses appended to a scenario body. Clauses are deliberately neutral to the scored decision (they add context, not a category or reply cue) so gold stays accurate, and they provide genuine wording variety. The public development pool ('groups') and each private split pool ('private_groups') are disjoint by construction: every private record therefore always contains a clause absent from any public record, which prevents a public example reappearing as private.
